dct_description_sm: At top of map: Panorama of the seat of war.

At top of map: Panorama of the seat of war. View of the coast from Currituck Sound, North Carolina, to Savannah, Georgia, indicating towns, roads, railroads, and rivers. The shelling of Fort Hatteras is shown. Includes a table of distances from Cape Hatteras. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale not given. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 304.5 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
